title: New Chapter for ‘The Daily’

body_markdown:
Paige Cowett has been promoted to editor in chief of “The Daily.” She brings on Nazanin Rafsanjani as managing editor. Read more from deputy managing editor, Sam Dolnick.


Over the last 10 years, “The Daily” has become a major planet in the media galaxy. That’s thanks to the team’s unparalleled news chops, storytelling creativity and tireless ambition.


But it’s also thanks to the team’s confident leaders who have demonstrated vision and roll-up-the-sleeves grit while steering the ship through one of the highest-stakes news cycles in generations. As “The Daily” approaches its second decade (!), I’m thrilled to announce the leaders who will chart the next chapter.


Photo Credit: Earl Wilson / NYT


Paige Cowett has been promoted to editor in chief of “The Daily.” Paige has been central to the show since its earliest days and has helped define its voice, sensibility and ambitions. With exceptional editorial judgment, Paige has guided coverage through historic elections, shocking and brutal wars, political upheavals and once-in-a-lifetime technological disruption. She has a deep understanding of the show, its audience and the team who makes it all possible, as well as a commitment to creative and independent journalism. As editor in chief, she will lead the show’s editorial direction, both in the day-to-day production, as well as its long-term priorities. Her desire to experiment with video and new formats so that we can continue growing and reaching new people will be central to her mandate.


Photo Credit: Earl Wilson / NYT


Photo Credit: Samira Blumberg


Nazanin Rafsanjani is joining “The Daily” in a new role as managing editor. Nazanin brings decades of experience across audio and TV journalism — at NPR, MSNBC and WNYC Radio — along with a track record of building successful teams and developing new storytelling formats. Nazanin was central to creating Gimlet Media, where she was one of its most prominent leaders through years of tremendous growth and success. She then obtained a law degree and worked in the legal department of media companies before making her way back to the editorial side.


At “The Daily,” Nazanin will work closely with Paige on managing the team and overseeing operations, helping to establish the show’s long-term vision and its editorial priorities and setting us up for growth. She will also partner with colleagues across the building to support the show and the team.


Nazanin starts on Nov. 17 and will report to Paige, who will report to me. Please join me in congratulating Paige and welcoming Nazanin to The Times.


— Sam
